purpose: Cross-Agent fallback detection for remote_control_view when agent-specific templates are absent.

cross_agent_remote_fallback.required_combination: At least two independent signals and no spectator/buy/tactical conflict.
signals: normal weapon/ammo HUD disappears or becomes structurally invalid
one ability slot transitions to active/controlling/cooldown state
dedicated remote reticle/overlay or non-player locomotion signature appears
normal player hands/weapon model absent for sustained frames
cross_agent_remote_fallback.subtype: unknown when no agent-specific template matches

safety: If remote-vs-live remains ambiguous, primary_state=unknown and suppress target-player mechanics.
